# llms.txt

Project: Legado Digital / Colegio Tancredo Neves
Repository root: c:\xampp\htdocs\cecmtancredoneves
Type: Static educational website
Language: pt-BR content, file naming mostly lowercase and path-based

## Purpose

This project is a digital exhibition website for student work from Colegio Tancredo Neves.
It showcases photos, subject pages, slides, books, handouts, and interactive educational content.
There is no backend and no build pipeline. The site is composed of static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, local assets, and PDF viewers.
Recent additions also include a policy/privacy area, a site map page, a cookie consent banner, anonymized display of student work titles, and a dedicated video catalog/viewer flow.
The site also now includes a Mathematics subject area with finance-oriented content, a responsive article page for financial education, and a unified archive that includes videos.
Recent work also added a quiz/simulado page, a Chemistry subject area kept out of the global menus, direct mural links to anchored sections inside the historical currency page, a renamed `diretrizes.html` route, a renamed `sitemap.html` route, and a dedicated visual updates/history page.

## Runtime model

- Served as a static site from XAMPP or any static host.
- Main local root is `c:\xampp\htdocs\cecmtancredoneves`.
- No package manager, bundler, framework, or server-side application code.
- Most page data is hardcoded directly inside HTML files through inline JavaScript arrays.

## Main routes

- `/index.html`: home page with hero, image slider, and featured subject entry
- `/materias.html`: subject index page
- `/mural.html`: photo wall
- `/slide.html`: presentation listing page
- `/trabalhos.html`: student work listing page with anonymized public titles
- `/acervo.html`: unified archive for photos, slides, books, handouts, and videos
- `/videos.html`: video listing page with search
- `/questoes.html`: quiz/simulado page with area filters and interactive help actions
- `/sobre.html`: project/about page
- `/diretrizes.html`: diretrizes, privacy/LGPD, and cookies information page
- `/sitemap.html`: site map page with grouped navigation links
- `/atualizacoes.html`: visual timeline/story page that summarizes major site updates
- `/visualizador-slide.html`: slide PDF viewer
- `/visualizador-apostilas.html`: handout viewer
- `/visualizador-livro.html`: book-style PDF viewer with page flip behavior
- `/visualizador-trabalhos.html`: work viewer in magazine/book style
- `/visualizador-video.html`: video viewer with presentation mode and previous/next navigation

## Asset folders

- `/image/`: photo gallery images used by home slider, mural, and archive
- `/slide/`: presentation PDFs
- `/livros/`: PDF books
- `/apostilas/`: PDF handouts
- `/assets/image/`: icons and favicon assets
- `/assets/audio/`: sound effects used by viewers and UI interactions

## CSS architecture

Entry point:
- `/css/style.css`

Imported shared layers:
- `/css/layout.css`: navbar, footer, container, shared grid structure
- `/css/components.css`: buttons, cards, media blocks, shared UI components
- `/css/pages.css`: page-specific layouts and hero sections

Additional page-specific styles:
- `/css/acervo.css`
- `/css/slide.css`
- `/css/visualizador.css`
- `/css/visualizador-livro.css`
- `/css/theme.css`

## JavaScript architecture

- `/js/main.js`: shared mobile menu toggle, menu normalization, privacy icon injection, floating alert behavior, cookie banner, scroll-to-top button, and progressive enhancement for the Beta badge label
- `/js/loader.js`: helper loader for the book viewer
- `/js/turn.min.js`: page flip dependency used by `visualizador-livro.html`

Viewer dependencies loaded from CDN inside HTML:
- PDF.js for slide and PDF rendering
- jQuery plus Turn.js flow for the book-like viewer
- Font Awesome icons in viewer pages

## Important content conventions

- Presentation assets must use the folder name `slide/`.
- The presentation page is `slide.html`.
- The presentation viewer is `visualizador-slide.html`.
- Do not reintroduce the old `slaides` naming pattern.
- Keep `slide.html`, `acervo.html`, and the real `/slide/` folder contents in sync; the current slide files use `-3a` naming.
- Navigation links are duplicated across many HTML files, so link changes usually need to be applied in multiple pages.
- The canonical institutional routes are now `diretrizes.html` and `sitemap.html`; avoid reintroducing the older `politicas.html` and `mapa-do-site.html` names.
- Subject cards and archive entries are not generated from a CMS; they are maintained manually.
- Chemistry exists as a real subject route but should remain hidden from the global navigation menus unless explicitly requested otherwise.
- The navbar receives progressive normalization via `js/main.js`, including a privacy/diretrizes icon and missing `Questões`/submenu links when needed.
- Cookie consent is stored in local browser storage under `cecmtan.cookies.choice`.
- The navbar logo transitions from blue to green on interaction, and the `Beta` badge expands inline to show "Em desenvolvimento".
- In navigation menus, the subject label may appear abbreviated as `Ed. Financeira`, while page titles should preserve `Educação Financeira`.
- Public titles for student work should avoid exposing student names and prefer turma + tema formatting.
- The floating home alert is intentionally compact and stacked vertically, with stronger mobile-specific adjustments.

## Where content lists live

- `/index.html`: image slider file list
- `/slide.html`: presentation list and thumbnail generation
- `/trabalhos.html`: work list and anonymized card titles
- `/acervo.html`: master archive lists for images, slides, books, handouts, and videos
- `/videos.html`: hardcoded YouTube catalog with local search
- `/questoes.html`: hardcoded question bank by subject area

## Editing guidance for agents

- Prefer editing shared CSS files before adding inline styles.
- Keep existing visual identity: blue `#173557`, green `#68813c`, white backgrounds, rounded cards.
- Preserve static hosting compatibility. Avoid introducing Node, build tools, or framework-specific assumptions unless explicitly requested.
- When renaming folders or files, update all hardcoded paths in HTML and inline JavaScript.
- If adding new assets, verify whether they also need to be added to `slide.html`, `acervo.html`, or home page sliders.
- If adding new subject content, check whether it should also appear in `materias.html`, `questoes.html`, `videos.html`, and `sitemap.html`.
- If adding or renaming major public pages, also review `history.txt`, `llms.txt`, and `atualizacoes.html`.
- If changing a shared route such as `slide.html` or a viewer page, review navbar links across root pages and subject pages.
- Book and handout flows use `visualizador-livro.html`.
- Presentation flows use `visualizador-slide.html`.
- Apostila flows use `visualizador-apostilas.html`.
- Work flows use `visualizador-trabalhos.html`.
- Video flows use `visualizador-video.html`.

## Maintenance notes

- `project_structure.md` is a generated structure snapshot and may need regeneration after large file moves.
- The repository may contain local content updates not reflected in README text.
- The project is content-heavy; asset path correctness matters more than code abstraction.
